description: Adobe Inc. builds software platforms and tools that empower everyone to create, providing solutions for creativity, productivity and personalized digital experiences that form the foundation of digital experiences and span the content workflow from the first creative spark through creation and production to personalized delivery across every channel. It serves business professionals, consumers, creators, creative professionals and marketing professionals with an end-to-end integrated platform spanning ideation, creation, production and activation, powered by Adobe's AI platform, and is weaving generative and agentic AI capabilities across its offerings through its commercially safe Firefly foundation models, an extensive ecosystem of partner models, and customer-customized models trained on licensed and public domain data.
